title: Yummy Turkish Pear Pide
description: A sour, fluffy Turkish flatbread filled with sweet Korean pear, cooked slowly in a bamboo steamer. It is cozy, low-FODMAP, and perfect for dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together rice flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until fully combined.
In a separate bowl beat the egg with honey, olive oil, yogurt, and lemon zest until smooth.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Divide the dough into four equal portions and roll each into a thin oval shape.
Spread a thin layer of mashed Korean pear onto each oval, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the pears to seal and create a pocket.
Place the prepared pide on a lightly oiled bamboo steamer basket and steam over simmering water for 20 minutes until the dough is puffed and tender.
Remove from steamer, let cool slightly, and serve warm with a drizzle of lemon yogurt sauce.
